metric_semantics.iq: equal-weight latest three valid samples per task; pass_rate * 150
metric_semantics.price: DeepSeek uses selectable off-peak/peak claim estimates; other models use mean latest actual_cost_usd; incomplete Codex ultra costs excluded
metric_semantics.combined_cost: average_price_usd * (average_minutes / 10) ^ 3.05323795 * 100; max valid point normalized to 100

adjacency_rule: Within each model+effort, observations are sorted by timestamp and only consecutive observations are compared.
interval_rule: <=6h, <=12h, and <=24h are cumulative upper bounds; 24-48h means >24h and <=48h; all means every positive interval.

formulas.std: population standard deviation: sqrt(sum((x - mean)^2) / n)
formulas.quantiles: linear interpolation on the sorted observed transition values

note: Cost noise is deliberately named cost_noise; it is not quota noise.
